title: Inverted Star Ontology: A vST-Aligned Regime Inversion Model
description: The Inverted Star Ontology (ISO) introduces a structural interpretation of compact astrophysical objects using Resonance-Transition Theory (RTT) and Validation-Space-Time (vST). Instead of treating black holes as singularities or endpoints, ISO models them as regime-inverted stars: coherent, lattice-phase structures formed through a resonance-to-lattice transition. This minimal artifact defines the inversion mechanism, the lattice-phase regime, the vST boundary, and the associated Structural Life-Regime Profile (SLRP).
